title: Sheikah Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Eightfold Blade Icon.png |caption= An Eightfold Blade |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= [[Stealth Attire]] |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Sheikah Gear|Sheikah Gear|BotW, AoC, Series}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 170}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Sheikah Gear is a series of weaponry made using techniques passed down within the [[Sheikah|Sheikah Tribe]], including [[Ancient Technology]].{{Cite|{{Big|Eightfold Blade}}
A single-edged sword traditional to the Sheikah tribe. Forged using ancient technology, it's said to be among the sharpest conventional weapons ever made.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Eightfold Longbalde}}
A single-edged sword seldom seen in Hyrule. This weapon is passed down through the Sheikah tribe and has an astonishingly sharp edge ideal for slicing.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Edge of Duality}}
A curious double-edged sword crafted using Sheikah technology. It was originally made for Hyrulean knights unfamiliar with single-edged blades.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Serpentine Spear}}
The spearhead of this weapon is uniquely Sheikah in design. Spear masters of the Sheikah tribe can use the crescent shape to snag their opponents and deliver brutal cuts.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Phrenic Bow}}
A bow passed down through the Sheikah tribe. Concentrating before drawing the string will allow you to target distant enemies as easily as those nearby.|Inventory|BotW}} Their blades are notable for possessing a single cutting edge and for being remarkably sharp. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the {{SSB}} Series [[Sheik]] [[amiibo]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a piece of Sheikah Gear. With the exception of the [[Phrenic Bow]], all types of Sheikah Gear are made out of metal. This means that they will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] Rune. Finally, the Sheikah Gear will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Eightfold Blade Icon.png|link=]]
